empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.description: When you get a ticket to an event, it shows up here.

notFound.title: This ticket doesn't exist
notFound.description: Check the link, or find your tickets in My tickets.

card.title: Tickets
card.description: Get your ticket here, then show its QR code at the door.
card.payNote: Secure payment through Stripe. {{club}} gets your name and email for check-in.
card.checkInNote: {{club}} gets your name and email for check-in.
card.showAtDoor: Show this QR code at the door. It's in your email too.

pass.showAtDoor: Show this QR code at the door.
pass.refundedNote: This ticket was refunded and can't be used.

door.teamNote: You run {{club}}, so you can check this ticket in.

results.refunded: Refunded ticket. Don't let them in.
results.wrong_date: This ticket is for a different date
results.not_for_this_event: This ticket is for a different event

return.prompt: Can't make it? Give your ticket back
return.title: Give your ticket back?
return.description: Someone else can take your spot. If any are left later, you can get a new ticket.

order.confirmingDescription: This usually takes a few seconds. Your tickets are also on their way by email.
order.paidDescription: You have {{count}} ticket. It's below and in your email.
order.paidDescription_other: You have {{count}} tickets. They're below and in your email.
order.shareNote: Each ticket has its own QR code. Send a ticket's link to the friend who's using it.
order.failedDescription: You weren't charged, and the tickets were released.

desk.title: Tickets
desk.setupDescription: Set a limit, add tiers with their own prices, then scan each ticket's QR code at the door.
desk.search: Search by name, email or code
desk.refundDescription: {{name}} gets {{amount}} back on their card, plus an email. Stripe doesn't return its fee to your club.
desk.declineDescription: {{name}} gets an email saying the club declined. Their ticket still works.
desk.cancelledDescription: Every paid ticket is refunded automatically. If some are still valid, Stripe was briefly unreachable: finish the rest here.

settings.tiersDescription: Each tier has its own name and price, and can have its own limit. Leave the price empty for free.
settings.nameRepeated: Each tier needs its own name.
settings.priceRange: Enter a price between {{minimum}} and {{maximum}}, or leave it empty.
settings.limitRange: Enter a number from 1 to {{maximum}}, or leave it empty for no limit.
settings.tierLocked: People have tickets in this tier, so it stays and its price can't change.
settings.paidComingSoon: Charging for tickets is coming soon. Until then, every tier is free.
settings.payoutsNeeded: Set up payouts to charge for tickets, so the money has somewhere to go.
settings.fees: Stripe keeps about 2.9% + 30¢ of each order. Your club gets the rest.
settings.limitDescription: The most tickets for the whole event, across every tier and date.
settings.goingNote: Everyone who already said they're going gets a ticket by email.
settings.pauseHint: Nobody new can get a ticket until you turn this off.
settings.turnedOff: This event no longer has tickets

refund.promptDescription: Ask {{club}} for a refund. They decide, and you'll get an email either way.
refund.signIn: Sign in to request a refund
refund.title: Ask {{club}} for a refund?
refund.description: If {{club}} agrees, the full price goes back to your card. You'll get an email either way.
refund.notePlaceholder: For example: I can't make the new date.
refund.pending: On {{date}}, you asked {{club}} for a refund. You'll get an email when they decide.
refund.declined: On {{date}}, {{club}} declined your refund request. Your ticket still works.
